scope: All GTD Healthcare GP practice anchors from the GTD Healthcare GP practices page, plus every NHS Find a GP surgery result within 1 mile of each GTD anchor.
notes: Google review fields were only filled when an exact or high-confidence Just Visits match was available.
Trustpilot fields were left blank because no reliable per-practice public source was found in this run.
NHS search pages sometimes include results beyond the requested radius, so the dataset additionally filters to 1.0 miles using the result-page distance text.
